CustomObject.description: Who gets alerted on a Meta lead sync failure, and how (Bell/Email/Both). A Custom Setting so it is always readable by Apex — including the Guest User running the inbound webhook, whose trigger-fired MetaLeadSyncFailureNotifier needs to read this list — regardless of sharing/FLS. User_Name__c/User_Email__c are captured flat at save time (Custom Settings can't hold a Lookup relationship) rather than read live off the User object.
CustomObject.label: Meta Notify Recipient
